-0,0 +1,172 @@
+name: Disposable CI lifecycle qualification
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      scenario:
+        description: Explicit real-service scenario; cancellation is performed by the operator
+        required: true
+        type: choice
+        options: [matrix, cancel-startup, cancel-execution]
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+# Every dispatch is a separate observation. Never cancel another qualification owner implicitly.
+concurrency:
+  group: lifecycle-${{ github.run_id }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  baseline:
+    uses: Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/.github/workflows/domain-ci-v2.yml@26991e8c542704be44cd8d9f58084d56fa627adb
+    with:
+      solution: Hexalith.Parties.Standalone.slnx
+      module-manifest: module/hexalith.module-manifest.v2.json
+      integration-test-profiles: platform-package
+      test-platform: microsoft-testing-platform
+      run-consumer-validation: true
+      run-coverage-gate: false
+      unit-test-projects: |
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.Aspire.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.Contracts.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.Authentication.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.Client.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.Server.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.Projections.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.Security.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.AdminPortal.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.ConsumerPortal.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.UI.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.Picker.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.Mcp.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.Sample.Tests
+        tests/Hexalith.Parties.Ci.Tests
+      build-timeout-minutes: 60
+    secrets:
+      registry-pull-username: ${{ secrets.HEXALITH_CI_REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
+      registry-pull-password: ${{ secrets.HEXALITH_CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}
+
+  qualification:
+    needs: baseline
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 45
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          submodules: false
+      - name: Initialize only direct owner dependencies
+        run: git -c submodule.recurse=false submodule update --init --depth 1
+      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@a98b56852c35b8e3190ac28c8c2271da59106c68 # v6.0.0
+        with:
+          global-json-file: global.json
+      - name: Prepare the actual pinned package tool and catalog
+        run: python3 -B references/Hexalith.Builds/Github/prepare-module-build/prepare_module_build.py --manifest module/hexalith.module-manifest.v2.json
+      - name: Build the explicit declared lifecycle suite
+        run: dotnet build tests/Hexalith.Parties.Platform.LifecycleTests/Hexalith.Parties.Platform.LifecycleTests.csproj --configuration Release -p:UseHexalithProjectReferences=false -p:UseNuGetDeps=true
+      - name: Read verified catalog toolchain versions
+        run: |
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
+          root = ET.parse('references/Hexalith.Builds/Props/Directory.Packages.props').getroot()
+          with Path(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV']).open('a') as output:
+              for name, property_name in [('CI_ASPIRE_VERSION', 'HexalithAspireAppHostSdkVersion'), ('CI_DAPR_CLI_VERSION', 'HexalithDaprCliVersion'), ('CI_DAPR_RUNTIME_VERSION', 'HexalithDaprRuntimeVersion')]:
+                  value = root.find('.//' + property_name).text
+                  if not value or any(character not in '0123456789.-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for character in value):
+                      raise ValueError('Invalid verified catalog toolchain version')
+                  output.write(name + '=' + value + '\n')
+          PY
+      - name: Install toolchain without provisioning services
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          tools="$RUNNER_TEMP/hexalith-lifecycle-tools"
+          dapr_home="$RUNNER_TEMP/hexalith-lifecycle-dapr"
+          mkdir -p "$tools" "$dapr_home/tools" "$dapr_home/.dapr/bin"
+          dotnet tool install --tool-path "$tools" Aspire.Cli --version "$CI_ASPIRE_VERSION"
+          curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' "https://github.com/dapr/cli/releases/download/v$CI_DAPR_CLI_VERSION/dapr_linux_amd64.tar.gz" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/lifecycle-dapr-cli.tar.gz"
+          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/lifecycle-dapr-cli.tar.gz" -C "$dapr_home/tools" dapr
+          for binary in daprd placement scheduler; do
+            curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' "https://github.com/dapr/dapr/releases/download/v$CI_DAPR_RUNTIME_VERSION/${binary}_linux_amd64.tar.gz" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/lifecycle-$binary.tar.gz"
+            tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/lifecycle-$binary.tar.gz" -C "$dapr_home/.dapr/bin" "$binary"
+          done
+          echo "$tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+          echo "HEXALITH_DAPR_HOME=$dapr_home" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - name: Configure only the dedicated pull reader
+        env:
+          REGISTRY_READER_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.HEXALITH_CI_REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
+          REGISTRY_READER_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.HEXALITH_CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}
+        run: |
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import base64
+          import json
+          import os
+          import tempfile
+          from pathlib import Path
+          username, password = (os.environ[key] for key in ['REGISTRY_READER_USERNAME', 'REGISTRY_READER_PASSWORD'])
+          if not username or not password:
+              raise ValueError('Dedicated pull-only reader is required')
+          directory = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='hexalith-lifecycle-registry.', dir=Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']).resolve(strict=True)))
+          with Path(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV']).open('a') as output:
+              output.write(f'DOCKER_CONFIG={directory}\nHEXALITH_LIFECYCLE_REGISTRY_CONFIG={directory}\n')
+          token = base64.b64encode((username + ':' + password).encode()).decode()
+          descriptor = os.open(directory / 'config.json', os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
+          with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'w') as output:
+              json.dump({'auths': {'registry.hexalith.com': {'auth': token}}}, output)
+          PY
+      - name: Exercise real passing failing partial-startup and exact retry scenarios
+        if: ${{ inputs.scenario == 'matrix' }}
+        run: python3 -B scripts/qualify-disposable-ci.py matrix
+      - name: Observe actual startup cancellation readiness
+        if: ${{ inputs.scenario == 'cancel-startup' }}
+        run: python3 -B scripts/qualify-disposable-ci.py start-cancellation --phase startup
+      - name: Observe actual execution cancellation readiness and active hold
+        if: ${{ inputs.scenario == 'cancel-execution' }}
+        run: python3 -B scripts/qualify-disposable-ci.py start-cancellation --phase execution
+      - name: Publish the actual ready owner before operator cancellation
+        if: ${{ inputs.scenario != 'matrix' }}
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
+        with:
+          name: lifecycle-cancellation-ready
+          path: TestResults/ci-lifecycle
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 14
+      - name: Await parent cancellation of this exact ready run
+        if: ${{ inputs.scenario != 'matrix' }}
+        run: python3 -B scripts/qualify-disposable-ci.py wait-cancellation
+      - name: Independently finalize every exact same-job owner
+        if: always()
+        env:
+          ACTUAL_JOB_STATUS: ${{ job.status }}
+        run: |
+          if [ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/hexalith-ci-qualification/journal.json" ]; then
+            python3 -B scripts/qualify-disposable-ci.py finalize --job-status "$ACTUAL_JOB_STATUS"
+          fi
+      - name: Remove the private reader file
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+          value = os.environ.get('HEXALITH_LIFECYCLE_REGISTRY_CONFIG')
+          if value:
+              path = Path(value)
+              root = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']).resolve(strict=True)
+              if path.parent != root or not path.name.startswith('hexalith-lifecycle-registry.') or path.is_symlink():
+                  raise ValueError('Refusing a foreign credential directory')
+              config = path / 'config.json'
+              if config.is_symlink():
+                  raise ValueError('Refusing a linked credential file')
+              config.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+              path.rmdir()
+          PY
+      - name: Retain classified lifecycle observations
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
+        with:
+          name: ci-lifecycle-observations
+          path: TestResults/ci-lifecycle
+          if-no-files-found: warn
+          retention-days: 14"},{"sha":"4dd096ba1cd237e83b024d77f9cb1cd309db5893","filename":"Hexalith.Parties.Standalone.slnx","status":"modified","additions":3,"deletions":0,"changes":3,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/blob/f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570/Hexalith.Parties.Standalone.slnx","raw_url":"https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/raw/f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570/Hexalith.Parties.Standalone.slnx","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/contents/Hexalith.Parties.Standalone.slnx?ref=f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570","patch":"@@ -37,6 +37,9 @@

+# Disposable CI lifecycle qualification
+
+This manual workflow is a dependent, **baseline-only** diagnostic proposal for
+Story 2.8. It grants no candidate acceptance or loaded-backend identity credit.
+The current 4.43.4/269 workflow/tool pins are deliberately unchanged. Published
+4.43.4 and 4.43.5 cannot allocate in the required direct-only checkout because of
+HXP020. A normally published corrected producer, qualified official archives,
+coherent genuinely released Platform tuple and normal owner adoption are required
+before dispatch. Preserve incoming root gitlinks; source preparation is not tuple
+qualification. Never initialize nested dependencies or substitute source runtime.
+
+The workflow must first be registered through normal main/source gates. After
+registration, the operator checks all normal exact-source CI gates, dispatches
+`.github/workflows/ci-lifecycle-qualification.yml` on that exact reviewed source,
+and records repository, revision, run, attempt and qualification job identities.
+The baseline job retains all 15 isolated projects, package consumers and required
+`platform-package` real-service suite. Its failure prevents the qualification job.
+Only the two dedicated pull-reader secrets are mapped; provider and publisher
+credentials are not used.
+
+| Input | Real observation |
+| --- | --- |
+| `matrix` | Passing and intentionally failing persistence suites; compatible same-job finite admission, explicitly disjoint negative context, completed-owner refusal; real owner-scoped metadata lock refusals and exact retry while an active peer remains functional; killed partial startup and exact recovery. |
+| `cancel-startup` | Durable issued receipt, actual Starting AppHost and owned containers; only the issued AppHost is paused to expose the real startup window. |
+| `cancel-execution` | Real gateway/Tenants/Memories and persisted EventStore assertions, native execution checkpoint and actual accepted 240-second hold. |
+
+The dedicated fixture reuses `PartyEnvironmentTests`' existing real persistence
+assertions. Missing descriptors or explicit controls fail, never skip. A passing
+release of the active peer reruns the full real dependency, command, query and
+exact-stream assertions. Only the initial call emits the canonical functional
+observation with CreateNew; rechecks require that first file and never overwrite
+or emit it again. Local filesystem controls reproduce duplicate-write refusal
+and byte preservation without supplying native/hosted credit. The declared execution
+limit is 300 seconds, fixture bound 240 seconds and production stop limit remains
+90 seconds. Slow startup or a missed window fails explicitly; no retry-to-green
+or timeout extension supplies credit.
+
+Every owner role and exact receipt/launch-record location is journaled before
+process creation. A test-controller child writes its actual PID, kernel birth and
+process group, then waits at most 30 seconds at a pipe gate. Only a successful
+durable parent bookkeeping save releases the unchanged public CLI command. Parent
+interruption closes the gate without native allocation. The independent finalizer
+recovers from the original intent and actual child record, including a constructor
+that never returned. Missing process proof or a released child without a receipt
+returns explicit unverified/non-success. A valid receipt still gets exact cleanup
+when process/result metadata is malformed; no uncertain launch verifies cleanup.
+Safe recovery observations remain outside the removed native workspaces.
+
+For each cancellation dispatch, fetch **that run's**
+`lifecycle-cancellation-ready` artifact before cancelling. Verify actual source,
+repository/run/attempt/job, issued owner identity, phase and timestamps against
+the live job and its wait step. Execution readiness must include the fixture's
+real persistence marker and the unexpired original admission. Only the parent
+operator may call GitHub's normal cancel API for that exact ready run. Save the
+API request/response and actual UTC request time separately; the controller does
+not cancel workflows. After the actual signal, the controller snapshots only the
+current receipt/job-bound owner state before any resume or forwarded signal.
+Startup credit requires actual Starting; execution credit requires Ready with
+the same live native process and original active finite admission. Missing or
+mismatched snapshots refuse credit after unconditional exact cleanup. A missing
+readiness artifact, expired hold or already
+terminal owner means no cancellation credit.
+
+The wait step permits 120 seconds for actual SIGINT/SIGTERM. It saves observed
+signals and any first terminal record before forwarding SIGINT to only the
+receipt-bound process group it created. Signal observation is **not** the API
+request time. The independent `always()` finalizer uses actual `job.status`,
+resumes only the recorded owned AppHost, invokes exact public `down --run-id`,
+and requires verified empty container/process/workspace/claim/discovery lists.
+It also checks the controller-owned invocation has exited. Every sibling is
+handled separately even when another fails.
+
+Cancellation requires actual `cancelled`/`Cancelled` terminal status/outcome and
+UTC time after the observed signal, original execution admission, durable
+`ci-job-cancelled` withdrawal before its original expiry, then identical first
+outcome/time and withdrawal/expiry through exact-owner retry. A pre-existing
+product failure is preserved with its actual terminal time and observed signal;
+it supplies no cancellation credit. Join its actual terminal time with the
+parent's API receipt to establish whether it truly preceded cancellation.
+Missing timing, changed first fields, unknown discovery or leftovers fails.
+
+`TestResults/ci-lifecycle` retains classified public command results, tool-manifest
+and mapping identities, real image reference/content IDs, receipt-issued owner
+metadata, admission/withdrawal observations and safe producer reports outside
+removed workspaces. Private descriptors, credentials and raw child stderr are
+excluded. Artifact absence after cancellation remains an explicit evidence gap;
+never infer cleanup from a cancelled job or a missing container list.
+
+Local controls (no service allocation and no hosted credit):
+
+```bash
+python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/ci-lifecycle -v
+python3 -B scripts/render-platform-declaration.py --check
+actionlint .github/workflows/ci-lifecycle-qualification.yml
+```
+
+Build the explicit LifecycleTests project only after supported pinned package
+preparation, using Release/package imports. Both ordinary solution builds keep
+this opt-in qualification project excluded. Record every genuine first outcome,
+including dependency or public API refusals. No schema, production fault hook,
+local retention policy, accepted pin or attached-suite execution is introduced."},{"sha":"3d6d716f11faa31bb7c674420767f26b0289c992","filename":"module/hexalith.module-manifest.v2.json","status":"modified","additions":9,"deletions":0,"changes":9,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/blob/f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570/module%2Fhexalith.module-manifest.v2.json","raw_url":"https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/raw/f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570/module%2Fhexalith.module-manifest.v2.json","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/contents/module%2Fhexalith.module-manifest.v2.json?ref=f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570","patch":"@@ -404,6 +404,15 @@

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Explicit hosted lifecycle observations; local controller tests provide no hosted credit."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import fcntl
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import select
+import signal
+import stat
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+    'integration_owner', ROOT / 'references/Hexalith.Builds/Github/run-module-integration/run_module_integration.py')
+HELPER = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
+_spec.loader.exec_module(HELPER)
+TOOL = ['dotnet', 'tool', 'run', 'hexalith-module', '--']
+RUN_ID = re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{32}')
+LABEL = 'hexalith.g4.run'
+MANIFEST = 'module/hexalith.module-manifest.v2.json'
+PROFILE = 'lifecycle-package'
+CANCELLED = []
+
+
+def now():
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def require(condition, message):
+    if not condition:
+        raise ValueError(message)
+
+
+def read(path):
+    path = Path(path)
+    require(not path.is_symlink(), 'Refusing linked qualification metadata')
+    info = path.stat()
+    require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and info.st_size <= 8_388_608,
+            'Refusing nonregular or oversized qualification metadata')
+    return json.loads(path.read_text())
+
+
+def private_directory(path):
+    path = Path(path)
+    require(not any(part.is_symlink() for part in (path, *path.parents)), 'Refusing linked qualification path')
+    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
+    return path
+
+
+def write(path, value):
+    path = Path(path)
+    private_directory(path.parent)
+    require(not path.exists() or (not path.is_symlink() and path.stat().st_nlink == 1), 'Unsafe evidence destination')
+    descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=path.name + '.', suffix='.new', dir=path.parent)
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'w') as output:
+            json.dump(value, output, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
+            output.write('\n')
+        os.replace(temporary, path)
+    finally:
+        Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
+
+def birth(pid):
+    try:
+        fields = Path(f'/proc/{pid}/stat').read_text().rpartition(')')[2].split()
+        return None if fields[0] == 'Z' else fields[19]
+    except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
+        return None
+
+
+def gated_exec(item, command):
+    """Test-controller handshake only; no CLI can execute before its real process record is durable."""
+    pid = os.getpid()
+    record = {key: item[key] for key in ('label', 'receipt', 'publicResult')}
+    record.update(pid=pid, birth=birth(pid), processGroup=os.getpgrp(), gateStatus='waiting', observedAtUtc=now())
+    require(record['birth'] is not None and record['processGroup'] == pid, 'Launch child is not its own actual process group')
+    write(item['launchRecord'], record)
+    readable, _, _ = select.select([sys.stdin.buffer], [], [], 30)
+    if not readable or sys.stdin.buffer.read(1) != b'1':
+        write(item['launchRecord'], {**record, 'gateStatus': 'closed', 'closedAtUtc': now()})
+        return 1
+    write(item['launchRecord'], {**record, 'gateStatus': 'released', 'releasedAtUtc': now()})
+    with open(os.devnull, 'rb') as empty:
+        os.dup2(empty.fileno(), sys.stdin.fileno())
+    os.execvp(command[0], command)
+
+
+def launch_owner(label):
+    context = HELPER.ci_context()
+    require(ROOT == HELPER.job_root('GITHUB_WORKSPACE'), 'Launch child must use the actual checkout root')
+    temporary = HELPER.job_root('RUNNER_TEMP') / 'hexalith-ci-qualification'
+    journal = read(temporary / 'journal.json')
+    require(journal['executionContext'] == context and journal['source'] == os.environ.get('GITHUB_SHA'),
+            'Launch intent belongs to another job or revision')
+    matches = [item for item in journal['owners'] if item['label'] == label]
+    require(label in ('passing', 'failing', 'peer', 'retry', 'partial', 'cancel') and len(matches) == 1,
+            'Launch child has no unique durable controller role')
+    item = matches[0]
+    for key, filename in [('receipt', 'receipt.json'), ('launchRecord', 'launch.json'), ('publicResult', 'public-result.json')]:
+        require(Path(item[key]) == temporary / label / filename, 'Launch intent escaped its exact controller role')
+    return gated_exec(item, TOOL + ['test', '--manifest=' + MANIFEST, '--mode=package', '--profile=' + PROFILE,
+                                  '--ci-owner-receipt=' + item['receipt'], '--output=json'])
+
+
+def first_outcome(record):
+    require(isinstance(record, dict) and isinstance(record.get('terminalOutcome'), dict),
+            'First outcome must have the actual structured result fields')
+    required = ('runId', 'ownerId', 'terminalStatus', 'terminalOutcome', 'terminalAtUtc', 'sourceMappingHash')
+    require(all(record.get(key) is not None for key in required), 'First-outcome identity, status, time or mapping is absent')
+    require(RUN_ID.fullmatch(record['runId']), 'First outcome has an invalid issued run identity')
+    utc(record['terminalAtUtc'])
+    return {key: record.get(key) for key in (*required, 'terminalCause')}
+
+
+def declared_terminal(record, action):
+    require(action in ('pass', 'fail'), 'Unknown declared qualification outcome')
+    first = first_outcome(record)
+    expected_status, expected_exit = ('completed', 'Success') if action == 'pass' else ('failed', 'ProductOrTest')
+    require(record.get('terminalStatus') == expected_status, 'Declared suite terminal status differs from the released contract')
+    require(record.get('terminalOutcome', {}).get('exitCode') == expected_exit,
+            'Declared suite terminal outcome contradicts its required passing/failing result')
+    return first
+
+
+def utc(value):
+    require(isinstance(value, str), 'An actual absolute UTC timestamp is required')
+    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
+    require(parsed.utcoffset() == timedelta(0), 'Timestamp must use UTC')
+    return parsed
+
+
+def cancellation_terminal(record, item, prior=None):
+    first = first_outcome(record)
+    require(item.get('cancellationPhase') in ('startup', 'execution'), 'Missing actual cancellation phase')
+    ready = utc(item.get('cancellationReadyAtUtc'))
+    signals = item.get('cancellationSignals', [])
+    require(signals and all(value.get('signal') in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM) for value in signals),
+            'Actual external cancellation signal evidence is absent')
+    received = min(utc(value.get('observedAtUtc')) for value in signals)
+    terminal = utc(first['terminalAtUtc'])
+    require(ready <= received, 'Cancellation signal preceded the actual ready checkpoint')
+    require(first['runId'] == item['runId'] and first['ownerId'] == item['runId'], 'Cancellation terminal owner differs')
+    if prior is not None:
+        require(first == prior, 'Finalization changed the first terminal outcome/time')
+    if first['terminalStatus'] == 'failed':
+        require(first['terminalOutcome'].get('exitCode') == 'ProductOrTest' and prior is not None and terminal <= received,
+                'Cancellation is obscured by an unqualified product/prerequisite failure')
+        # The API request happened before this runner signal. Only the parent's API receipt can order it.
+        return 'product-failure-before-observed-signal'
+    require(first['terminalStatus'] == 'cancelled' and first['terminalOutcome'].get('exitCode') == 'Cancelled',
+            'Actual cancellation status/outcome differs from the released contract')
+    require(received <= terminal <= datetime.now(timezone.utc), 'Cancellation terminal time is outside actual signal/finalization')
+    return 'cancelled'
+
+
+def active_attachment(attachment, run_id):
+    identities = ('ownerRunId', 'attachedRunId', 'originalAttachmentRequestId', 'environmentId')
+    require(all(isinstance(attachment.get(key), str) and RUN_ID.fullmatch(attachment[key]) for key in identities),
+            'Admission lacks real issued identities')
+    require(attachment['ownerRunId'] == run_id and attachment.get('requestedHoldSeconds') == 240
+            and attachment.get('effectiveHoldSeconds') == 240, 'Admission changed the requested finite hold')
+    require(isinstance(attachment.get('acceptedAtUtc'), str) and isinstance(attachment.get('expiresAtUtc'), str),
+            'Admission lacks actual acceptance/expiry timestamps')
+    accepted = datetime.fromisoformat(attachment['acceptedAtUtc'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
+    expires = datetime.fromisoformat(attachment['expiresAtUtc'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
+    require(accepted.tzinfo is not None and expires - accepted == timedelta(seconds=240)
+            and expires > datetime.now(timezone.utc), 'The original finite hold is not active')
+    require(attachment.get('endedAtUtc') is None and attachment.get('outcome') is None, 'Admission hold already ended')
+
+
+def same_expiry(first, observed):
+    keys = ('originalAttachmentRequestId', 'attachedRunId', 'acceptedAtUtc', 'expiresAtUtc', 'effectiveHoldSeconds')
+    require(all(first.get(key) == observed.get(key) for key in keys), 'Attachment lineage or original expiry changed')
+
+
+def owned_native_process(pid, run_id):
+    require(isinstance(pid, int) and pid > 1, 'Native checkpoint has no actual process identity')
+    started = birth(pid)
+    require(started is not None and ('HEXALITH_G4_RUN_ID=' + run_id).encode()
+            in Path(f'/proc/{pid}/environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0'), 'Native execution is absent, reused or not owned')
+    return {'processId': pid, 'birth': started}
+
+
+def cancellation_phase(item, owner, context):
+    snapshot = item.get('cancellationSnapshot')
+    require(isinstance(snapshot, dict) and 'failureType' not in snapshot, 'Actual signal-time owner snapshot is unavailable')
+    require(all(snapshot.get(key) == owner[key] for key in ('runId', 'attemptId', 'environmentId'))
+            and snapshot.get('executionContext') == owner['executionContext'] == context, 'Signal-time owner/job binding differs')
+    received = min(utc(value['observedAtUtc']) for value in item['cancellationSignals'])
+    observed = utc(snapshot['observedAtUtc'])
+    require(utc(item['cancellationReadyAtUtc']) <= received <= utc(snapshot['readStartedAtUtc']) <= observed,
+            'Owner snapshot was not observed after the actual external signal')
+    require(utc(snapshot['stateUpdatedAtUtc']) <= observed, 'Owner state time is ahead of the actual snapshot')
+    require('firstOutcome' in snapshot and 'stateTestTerminal' in snapshot
+            and snapshot['firstOutcome'] is None and snapshot['stateTestTerminal'] is None,
+            'Owner had a terminal outcome at the cancellation phase observation')
+    if item['cancellationPhase'] == 'startup':
+        require(snapshot.get('status') == 'Starting' and snapshot.get('nativeExecution') is None,
+                'Requested startup cancellation was not observed in actual Starting state')
+        return
+    require(item['cancellationPhase'] == 'execution' and snapshot.get('status') == 'Ready',
+            'Requested execution cancellation was not observed in an active Ready owner')
+    checkpoint = item['executionCheckpoint']
+    require(checkpoint.get('runId') == owner['runId'] and checkpoint.get('realPersistenceAssertionsPassed') is True
+            and snapshot.get('nativeExecution') == {key: checkpoint[key] for key in ('processId', 'birth')},
+            'Original native execution is no longer running in the signal-time snapshot')
+    admitted, active = item['admission'], snapshot['admission']
+    same_expiry(admitted, active)
+    require(active.get('ownerRunId') == owner['runId'] and active.get('environmentId') == owner['environmentId']
+            and active.get('requestedHoldSeconds') == active.get('effectiveHoldSeconds') == 240
+            and active.get('endedAtUtc') is None and active.get('outcome') is None,
+            'Signal-time admission is not the actual active original finite hold')
+    require(utc(active['acceptedAtUtc']) <= received <= observed < utc(active['expiresAtUtc'])
+            and utc(active['expiresAtUtc']) - utc(active['acceptedAtUtc']) == timedelta(seconds=240),
+            'Original finite hold was not active at the actual signal and snapshot')
+

+class Qualification:
+    """Own only receipt-issued siblings from the current real GitHub job."""
+
+    def __init__(self, finalizing=False):
+        self.context = HELPER.ci_context()
+        require(ROOT == HELPER.job_root('GITHUB_WORKSPACE'), 'Qualification must use the actual checkout root')
+        self.temporary = private_directory(HELPER.job_root('RUNNER_TEMP') / 'hexalith-ci-qualification')
+        self.evidence = private_directory(ROOT / 'TestResults/ci-lifecycle')
+        self.journal_path = self.temporary / 'journal.json'
+        self.children = {}
+        head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
+        require(head == os.environ.get('GITHUB_SHA'), 'Checkout is not the workflow source revision')
+        HELPER.verify_tool(ROOT)
+        mapping = None
+        if not finalizing:
+            HELPER.verify_preparation()
+            mapping = read(Path(os.environ['CustomAfterMicrosoftCommonProps']).parent / 'mapping.json')
+            require(mapping.get('Root') == str(ROOT) and mapping.get('ContentHash') == os.environ['HEXALITH_SOURCE_MAPPING_HASH'],
+                    'Qualification mapping differs from the strict prepared source')
+        self.journal = read(self.journal_path) if self.journal_path.exists() else {
+            'schema': 'hexalith.ci-lifecycle-qualification.v1', 'classification': 'baseline-only',
+            'source': head, 'mappingHash': mapping['ContentHash'] if mapping else None,
+            'executionContext': self.context, 'owners': [], 'observations': []}
+        require(self.journal['executionContext'] == self.context and self.journal['source'] == head,
+                'Refusing another job or revision journal')
+        require(isinstance(self.journal.get('mappingHash'), str) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', self.journal['mappingHash']),
+                'The durable journal lacks the actual prepared mapping identity')
+        if mapping is not None:
+            require(self.journal['mappingHash'] == mapping['ContentHash'], 'Prepared mapping changed within this job')
+        self.save()
+        if mapping is not None and not (self.evidence / 'inputs.json').exists():
+            write(self.evidence / 'inputs.json', {'source': head, 'executionContext': self.context,
+                  'toolManifestSha256': hashlib.sha256((ROOT / '.config/dotnet-tools.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+                  'mappingHash': mapping['ContentHash'], 'platformIdentity': mapping.get('PlatformIdentity'),
+                  'candidateAcceptance': False})
+
+    def save(self):
+        write(self.journal_path, self.journal)
+        write(self.evidence / 'observations.json', self.journal)
+
+    def observe(self, kind, **values):
+        item = {'kind': kind, 'observedAtUtc': now(), **values}
+        self.journal['observations'].append(item)
+        self.save()
+        print(json.dumps(item), flush=True)
+
+    def owner(self, label):
+        return next(item for item in self.journal['owners'] if item['label'] == label)
+
+    def issued(self, item):
+        require(item.get('label') in ('passing', 'failing', 'peer', 'retry', 'partial', 'cancel'), 'Unknown controller owner role')
+        expected = self.temporary / item['label'] / 'receipt.json'
+        require(Path(item['receipt']) == expected and not expected.is_symlink(), 'Receipt escaped its issued controller role')
+        return HELPER.receipt_owner(expected, self.context)
+
+    def state(self, item):
+        owner = self.issued(item)
+        directory = Path(owner['stateDirectory'])
+        paths = [directory / (owner['runId'] + '.json'), directory / 'diagnostics' / owner['runId'] / 'owner.json']
+        path = next((path for path in paths if path.exists()), None)
+        if path is None:
+            raise FileNotFoundError('Owner metadata has not yet been published')
+        value = read(path)
+        require(value.get('runId') == owner['runId'] and value.get('executionContext') == self.context,
+                'Owner metadata lost its actual job binding')
+        return value
+
+    def diagnostics(self, item):
+        owner = self.issued(item)
+        return Path(owner['stateDirectory']) / 'diagnostics' / owner['runId']
+
+    def control(self, item, action):
+        require(action in ('wait', 'pass', 'fail'), 'Unsupported fixture action')
+        owner = self.issued(item)
+        directory = private_directory(Path(owner['stateDirectory']).parent / 'ci-qualification' / owner['runId'])
+        value = {'runId': owner['runId'], 'action': action}
+        write(directory / 'control.json', value)
+        self.observe('fixture-control', ownerRunId=owner['runId'], action=action,
+                     configurationSha256=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest())
+        return directory
+
+    def tool(self, item, arguments, tag, environment=None):
+        owner = self.issued(item)
+        result = subprocess.run(TOOL + arguments, cwd=ROOT, env=environment, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+                                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=150, check=False)
+        value = HELPER.read_json(result.stdout)
+        write(self.evidence / (item['label'] + '-' + tag + '.json'), value)
+        self.observe(tag, ownerRunId=owner['runId'], exitCode=result.returncode, result=value)
+        return result, value
+
+    def containers(self, item):
+        owner = self.issued(item)
+        output = subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'ps', '-aq', '--filter', f'label={LABEL}={owner["runId"]}'], text=True, timeout=20)
+        identities = output.split()
+        require(all(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{12,64}', value) for value in identities), 'Docker discovery returned invalid identities')
+        return identities
+
+    def peer_scope(self, item):
+        owner = self.issued(item)
+        state = self.state(item)
+        require(state['status'] == 'Ready' and state.get('testRun') is None, 'Peer is not an active ready owner')
+        workspace = Path(state['workspace'])
+        require(workspace.is_dir() and not workspace.is_symlink(), 'Peer workspace is unavailable')
+        pid = state.get('appHostProcessId')
+        require(pid is not None and birth(pid) is not None, 'Peer AppHost is unavailable')
+        claims_root = Path(owner['stateDirectory']) / 'claims'
+        claim_ids = read(claims_root / 'owners' / (owner['runId'] + '.json'))
+        require(isinstance(claim_ids, list), 'Peer claim receipt is unavailable')
+        claims = {}
+        for claim in claim_ids:
+            require(isinstance(claim, str) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', claim), 'Peer claim identity is invalid')
+            path = claims_root / (claim + '.json')
+            record = read(path)
+            require(record.get('OwnerRunId') == owner['runId'], 'Peer claim ownership changed')
+            claims[claim] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        return {'containers': sorted(self.containers(item)), 'workspace': str(workspace),
+                'appHostProcessId': pid, 'appHostBirth': birth(pid), 'claimHashes': claims}
+
+    def record_images(self, item):
+        records = []
+        for identity in self.containers(item):
+            label = subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'inspect', '--format', '{{index .Config.Labels "' + LABEL + '"}}', identity], text=True, timeout=20).strip()
+            require(label == self.issued(item)['runId'], 'Refusing foreign container observation')
+            template = '{{json .Id}}\t{{json .Config.Image}}\t{{json .Image}}'
+            fields = subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'inspect', '--format', template, identity], text=True, timeout=20).strip().split('\t')
+            records.append(dict(zip(('containerId', 'imageReference', 'imageContentId'), map(json.loads, fields))))
+        require(records, 'Real owned container identities are required')
+        self.observe('actual-images', ownerRunId=self.issued(item)['runId'], images=records)
+
+    def poll(self, item, predicate, seconds):
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
+        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+            path = Path(item['receipt'])
+            if path.exists():
+                self.issued(item)
+                try:
+                    if predicate():
+                        return
+                except FileNotFoundError:
+                    pass
+            child = self.children.get(item['label'])
+            if child is not None and child.poll() is not None:
+                self.capture_result(item)
+                raise ValueError('Owner terminated before the required real checkpoint')
+            require(not CANCELLED, 'Actual external cancellation interrupted the observation')
+            time.sleep(0.1)
+        raise TimeoutError('Required real lifecycle checkpoint was not observed within its finite bound')
+
+    def recover_launch(self, item):
+        require(item.get('label') in ('passing', 'failing', 'peer', 'retry', 'partial', 'cancel'), 'Unknown launch recovery role')
+        for key, filename in [('receipt', 'receipt.json'), ('publicResult', 'public-result.json')]:
+            require(Path(item[key]) == self.temporary / item['label'] / filename, 'Launch recovery escaped its exact receipt/output role')
+        expected = self.temporary / item['label'] / 'launch.json'
+        require(Path(item['launchRecord']) == expected, 'Launch record escaped its exact controller role')
+        private_directory(expected.parent)
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
+        while not expected.exists() and time.monotonic() < deadline:
+            time.sleep(0.05)
+        record = read(expected)
+        require(isinstance(record, dict), 'Launch process record is malformed')
+        require(all(record.get(key) == item[key] for key in ('label', 'receipt', 'publicResult')),
+                'Launch process record differs from its durable role/receipt intent')
+        require(isinstance(record.get('pid'), int) and record['pid'] > 1
+                and record.get('processGroup') == record['pid']
+                and isinstance(record.get('birth'), str) and record['birth'].isdigit()
+                and record.get('gateStatus') in ('waiting', 'closed', 'released'), 'Actual launch process identity is unavailable')
+        if birth(record['pid']) == record['birth']:
+            require(os.getpgid(record['pid']) == record['processGroup'], 'Launch process group changed')
+        item.update({key: record[key] for key in ('pid', 'birth', 'processGroup')})
+        item['launchGateStatus'] = record['gateStatus']
+        return record
+
+    def launch(self, item):
+        require(not Path(item['launchRecord']).exists(), 'Do not replace a previous launch process record')
+        descriptor = os.open(item['publicResult'], os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
+        child = None
+        try:
+            with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'w') as stream:
+                child = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-B', str(Path(__file__).resolve()), '--launch-owner', item['label']],
+                                         cwd=ROOT, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+                                         start_new_session=True, bufsize=0)
+            self.children[item['label']] = child
+            record = self.recover_launch(item)
+            require(child.pid == record['pid'] and birth(child.pid) == record['birth'] and record['gateStatus'] == 'waiting',
+                    'Launch gate is not waiting in its actual created child')
+            self.save()
+            require(child.stdin.write(b'1') == 1, 'Launch gate was not released')
+        finally:
+            if child is not None and child.stdin is not None:
+                child.stdin.close()
+
+    def finish_unissued_launch(self, item):
+        record = self.recover_launch(item)
+        if birth(record['pid']) == record['birth']:
+            self.process_signal(item, signal.SIGINT)
+            self.settled_child(item)
+        if Path(item['receipt']).exists():
+            return False
+        record = self.recover_launch(item)
+        require(birth(record['pid']) != record['birth'], 'Unissued launch child is still able to execute')
+        require(record['gateStatus'] in ('waiting', 'closed'), 'Released launch lacks a recoverable receipt; allocation is uncertain')
+        self.observe('not-allocated-before-launch-gate', label=item['label'], actualProcessId=record['pid'], gateStatus=record['gateStatus'])
+        return True
+
+    def start(self, label, startup=False, cancellation_phase=None):
+        require(label not in [item['label'] for item in self.journal['owners']], 'Do not replace an existing owner attempt')
+        directory = private_directory(self.temporary / label)
+        item = {'label': label, 'receipt': str(directory / 'receipt.json'),
+                'launchRecord': str(directory / 'launch.json'), 'publicResult': str(directory / 'public-result.json')}
+        if cancellation_phase is not None:
+            item['cancellationPhase'] = cancellation_phase
+        self.journal['owners'].append(item)

+    def cancellation_snapshot(self, item):

+            snapshot['stateTestTerminal'] = first_outcome(state['testRun']) if state.get('testRun') is not None else None

+            snapshot['firstOutcome'] = first_outcome(read(terminal)) if terminal.exists() else None

+            if item['cancellationPhase'] == 'execution':

+                require(isinstance(document, dict) and isinstance(document.get('attachments'), list),

+                active = next((value for value in document['attachments']
+                               if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('attachedRunId') == admitted['attachedRunId']), None)

+            snapshot['failureType'] = type(error).__name__
+        snapshot['observedAtUtc'] = now()

+        self.save()

+    def capture_result(self, item):

+            if path.stat().st_size:
+                value = read(path)

+                             exitCode=child.returncode, result=value)

+    def attach(self, item, tag, negative=False, previous=None):
+        state = self.state(item)
+        command = ['attach', '--owner-run-id=' + state['runId'], '--mode=package',
+                   '--composition-identity=' + state['manifestHash'], '--hold-seconds=240', '--output=json']
+        if previous:
+            command.append('--attachment-request-id=' + previous['originalAttachmentRequestId'])
+        environment = os.environ.copy()
+        if negative:
+            environment['GITHUB_JOB'] = self.context['jobId'] + '-disjoint-negative-probe'
+        attachments = self.diagnostics(item) / 'attachments.json'
+        before = read(attachments) if attachments.exists() else None
+        completed, result = self.tool(item, command, tag, environment)
+        if negative:
+            require((read(attachments) if attachments.exists() else None) == before, 'Negative probe recorded an attachment')
+            require(completed.returncode != 0 and result.get('attachment') is None, 'Disjoint job probe was accepted')
+            require(any(value.get('ruleId') == 'HXR033' for value in result.get('diagnostics', [])), 'Missing job-context refusal')
+            self.observe('negative-context-only', callerJob=environment['GITHUB_JOB'], actualJob=self.context['jobId'])
+            return None
+        require(completed.returncode == 0 and result.get('attachment'), 'Real same-job finite admission was refused')
+        attachment = result['attachment']
+        active_attachment(attachment, state['runId'])
+        if previous:
+            same_expiry(previous, attachment)
+        return attachment
+
+    def archived(self, item):
+        owner = self.issued(item)
+        destination = private_directory(self.evidence / item['label'])
+        HELPER.retain_artifacts(owner, destination)
+        result = read(self.diagnostics(item) / 'selected-test.json')
+        require(result.get('runId') == owner['runId'] and result.get('sourceMappingHash') == self.journal['mappingHash'],
+                'Terminal outcome belongs to another owner or prepared mapping')
+        return result

+    def withdrawn(self, item, admitted, reason=None):
+        document = read(self.diagnostics(item) / 'attachments.json')
+        require(isinstance(document, dict) and isinstance(document.get('attachments'), list), 'Withdrawal document is absent or malformed')
+        observed = next((value for value in document['attachments']
+                         if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('attachedRunId') == admitted['attachedRunId']), None)
+        require(observed is not None, 'The admitted attachment is missing from the durable withdrawal document')
+        same_expiry(admitted, observed)
+        require(observed.get('outcome') == 'withdrawn' and observed.get('endedAtUtc') is not None,
+                'CI cleanup did not durably withdraw the active hold')
+        require(observed.get('endReason') in ('ci-job-completed', 'ci-job-cancelled')
+                and (reason is None or observed['endReason'] == reason), 'Hold ended by expiry or an unexpected reason')
+        require(datetime.fromisoformat(observed['endedAtUtc'].replace('Z', '+00:00'))
+                < datetime.fromisoformat(observed['expiresAtUtc'].replace('Z', '+00:00')), 'Withdrawal did not precede original expiry')
+        self.observe('actual-withdrawal', ownerRunId=self.issued(item)['runId'], attachment=observed)
+        return observed

+    def down(self, item, tag, expected=True, job_status=''):
+        owner = self.issued(item)
+        environment = os.environ.copy()
+        if job_status:
+            environment['HEXALITH_CI_JOB_STATUS'] = job_status
+        completed, result = self.tool(item, ['down', '--run-id=' + owner['runId'], '--output=json'], tag, environment)
+        verified = HELPER.cleanup_verified(completed, result, owner)
+        require(verified == expected, 'Exact-owner cleanup result did not match the explicit qualification condition')
+        if verified:
+            require(not self.containers(item), 'Independent exact-label discovery still finds owned containers')
+        return result

+    def settled_child(self, item):
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + 90
+        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+            child = self.children.get(item['label'])
+            if child is not None and child.poll() is not None:
+                return
+            if birth(item['pid']) != item['birth']:
+                return
+            time.sleep(0.1)
+        raise TimeoutError('The exact controller-owned invocation remains after resource cleanup')

+    def process_signal(self, item, number):
+        require(birth(item['pid']) == item['birth'], 'Refusing a missing or reused controller process')
+        require(os.getpgid(item['pid']) == item['processGroup'] == item['pid'], 'Refusing a foreign process group')
+        owner = self.issued(item) if Path(item['receipt']).exists() else None
+        os.killpg(item['processGroup'], number)
+        self.observe('owned-process-signal', ownerRunId=owner['runId'] if owner else None, pid=item['pid'], signal=number)

+    def pause_host(self, item):
+        state = self.state(item)
+        pid = state['appHostProcessId']
+        require(state['status'] == 'Starting' and birth(pid) is not None, 'No actual starting AppHost to pause')
+        require(('HEXALITH_G4_RUN_ID=' + state['runId']).encode() in Path(f'/proc/{pid}/environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0'),

+    def resume_host(self, item):

+        if paused and birth(paused['pid']) == paused['birth']:
+            self.issued(item)
+            os.kill(paused['pid'], signal.SIGCONT)
+            self.observe('owned-host-resumed', ownerRunId=self.issued(item)['runId'], pid=paused['pid'])

+    def ordinary(self, label, action):

+        self.attach(item, label + '-cross-job', negative=True)
+        admitted = self.attach(item, label + '-same-job')

+    def retry_with_peer(self):

+    def finalize(self, job_status):

+namespace Hexalith.Parties.Platform.IntegrationTests;
+
+/// <summary>Writes one canonical native observation; post-hold rechecks preserve that first file.</summary>
+internal static class FunctionalObservationWriter
+{
+    /// <summary>Records the initial observation or verifies that a recheck has an existing canonical observation.</summary>
+    /// <param name="bytes">The bounded, unchanged observation serialization.</param>
+    /// <param name="descriptor">The owning runner descriptor path.</param>
+    /// <param name="report">The owning native TRX report path.</param>
+    /// <param name="recordCanonicalObservation">Whether this is the initial canonical write.</param>
+    /// <param name="token">The bounded test token.</param>
+    /// <returns>The single initial write or read-only recheck of the canonical file's presence.</returns>
+    internal static async Task WriteAsync(byte[] bytes, string? descriptor, string? report, bool recordCanonicalObservation, CancellationToken token)
+    {
+        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(descriptor) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(report)
+            || !Path.IsPathFullyQualified(descriptor) || !Path.IsPathFullyQualified(report))
+            throw new InvalidOperationException("The explicit owning native observation binding is unavailable.");
+        string workspace = Path.GetDirectoryName(Path.GetFullPath(descriptor))!;
+        string directory = Path.Combine(workspace, "native-tests");
+        if (Path.GetDirectoryName(Path.GetFullPath(report)) != directory || Path.GetFileName(report) != "native.trx"
+            || !Directory.Exists(directory))
+            throw new InvalidOperationException("The native report differs from the descriptor-owned output directory.");
+        if (bytes.Length > 65536) throw new InvalidOperationException("The native observation exceeds its bounded output contract.");
+        string path = Path.Combine(directory, "functional-observations.json");
+        if (!recordCanonicalObservation)
+        {
+            FileInfo original = new(path);
+            if (!original.Exists || original.LinkTarget is not null || original.Length > 65536)
+                throw new InvalidOperationException("The original canonical observation is unavailable for the recheck.");
+            return;
+        }
+        var options = new FileStreamOptions
+        {
+            Mode = FileMode.CreateNew, Access = FileAccess.Write, Share = FileShare.None, Options = FileOptions.Asynchronous,
+        };
+        if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows()) options.UnixCreateMode = UnixFileMode.UserRead | UnixFileMode.UserWrite;
+        FileStream stream = new(path, options);
+        await using (stream.ConfigureAwait(false))
+        {
+            await stream.WriteAsync(bytes, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
+            await stream.FlushAsync(token).ConfigureAwait(false);
+        }
+    }
+}"},{"sha":"8fa4b6d0460d1201cde1161a4123d2cad4a5315c","filename":"tests/Hexalith.Parties.Platform.IntegrationTests/FunctionalObservationWriterTests.cs","status":"added","additions":68,"deletions":0,"changes":68,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/blob/f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570/tests%2FHexalith.Parties.Platform.IntegrationTests%2FFunctionalObservationWriterTests.cs","raw_url":"https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/raw/f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570/tests%2FHexalith.Parties.Platform.IntegrationTests%2FFunctionalObservationWriterTests.cs","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/contents/tests%2FHexalith.Parties.Platform.IntegrationTests%2FFunctionalObservationWriterTests.cs?ref=f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+using System.Security.Cryptography;
+using System.Text;
+
+namespace Hexalith.Parties.Platform.IntegrationTests;
+
+/// <summary>Exercises actual bounded local file I/O only; no native environment or hosted credit is supplied.</summary>
+/// <param name="output">The local diagnostic output.</param>
+public sealed class FunctionalObservationWriterTests(ITestOutputHelper output)
+{
+    /// <summary>Reproduces duplicate CreateNew refusal and proves the recheck preserves the first canonical bytes.</summary>
+    /// <returns>The bounded real-file control.</returns>
+    [Fact]
+    public async Task DuplicateCanonicalWriteRefusesWhileRecheckPreservesOriginalBytesAsync()
+    {
+        string root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "parties-observation-io-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
+        string directory = Path.Combine(root, "native-tests");
+        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
+        string descriptor = Path.Combine(root, "local-io-control-not-a-runner-descriptor.json");
+        string report = Path.Combine(directory, "native.trx");
+        byte[] first = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("{\"classification\":\"local-io-control-only\",\"value\":\"first\"}");
+        byte[] recheck = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("{\"classification\":\"local-io-control-only\",\"value\":\"recheck\"}");
+        using var bound = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
+        bound.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
+        try
+        {
+            await FunctionalObservationWriter.WriteAsync(first, descriptor, report, true, bound.Token).ConfigureAwait(true);
+            string path = Path.Combine(directory, "functional-observations.json");
+            IOException duplicate = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<IOException>(() =>
+                FunctionalObservationWriter.WriteAsync(recheck, descriptor, report, true, bound.Token)).ConfigureAwait(true);
+            Assert.Equal(first, await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(path, bound.Token).ConfigureAwait(true));
+            await FunctionalObservationWriter.WriteAsync(recheck, descriptor, report, false, bound.Token).ConfigureAwait(true);
+            await FunctionalObservationWriter.WriteAsync(recheck, descriptor, report, false, bound.Token).ConfigureAwait(true);
+            Assert.Equal(first, await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(path, bound.Token).ConfigureAwait(true));
+            if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows())
+                Assert.Equal(UnixFileMode.UserRead | UnixFileMode.UserWrite, File.GetUnixFileMode(path));
+            output.WriteLine($"Local I/O control only; duplicate={duplicate.GetType().Name}; rechecks=2; canonicalBytesPreserved=true; firstSha256={Convert.ToHexStringLower(SHA256.HashData(first))}; nativeQualification=false.");
+        }
+        finally
+        {
+            Directory.Delete(root, recursive: true);
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// <summary>Refuses a recheck without its first observation, wrong ownership paths and oversized output.</summary>
+    /// <returns>The bounded negative I/O controls.</returns>
+    [Fact]
+    public async Task RecheckRequiresOriginalAndPreservesOutputOwnershipBoundsAsync()
+    {
+        string root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "parties-observation-io-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
+        string directory = Path.Combine(root, "native-tests");
+        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
+        string descriptor = Path.Combine(root, "local-io-control-not-a-runner-descriptor.json");
+        string report = Path.Combine(directory, "native.trx");
+        using var bound = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
+        bound.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
+        try
+        {
+            await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => FunctionalObservationWriter.WriteAsync([1], descriptor, report, false, bound.Token)).ConfigureAwait(true);
+            await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => FunctionalObservationWriter.WriteAsync([1], descriptor, Path.Combine(root, "native.trx"), true, bound.Token)).ConfigureAwait(true);
+            await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() => FunctionalObservationWriter.WriteAsync(new byte[65537], descriptor, report, true, bound.Token)).ConfigureAwait(true);
+            Assert.False(File.Exists(Path.Combine(directory, "functional-observations.json")));
+        }
+        finally
+        {
+            Directory.Delete(root, recursive: true);
+        }
+    }
+}"},{"sha":"ae6696bfcc076c9a65205ebc0fece9ecb61a3e0d","filename":"tests/Hexalith.Parties.Platform.IntegrationTests/PartyEnvironmentTests.cs","status":"modified","additions":171,"deletions":183,"changes":354,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/blob/f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570/tests%2FHexalith.Parties.Platform.IntegrationTests%2FPartyEnvironmentTests.cs","raw_url":"https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/raw/f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570/tests%2FHexalith.Parties.Platform.IntegrationTests%2FPartyEnvironmentTests.cs","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/contents/tests%2FHexalith.Parties.Platform.IntegrationTests%2FPartyEnvironmentTests.cs?ref=f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570","patch":"@@ -1,183 +1,171 @@

+            if (response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.OK)
+            {
+                using JsonDocument document = JsonDocument.Parse(await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(token).ConfigureAwait(true));

+            }
+            else if (response.StatusCode != HttpStatusCode.NotFound && response.StatusCode != HttpStatusCode.ServiceUnavailable)
+            {
+                throw new InvalidOperationException($"The authenticated Party query failed with HTTP {(int)response.StatusCode}.");
+            }
+            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(250), token).ConfigureAwait(true);
+        }
+    }

+using System.Security.Cryptography;
+using System.Text.Json;
+
+using Hexalith.Parties.Platform.IntegrationTests;
+
+namespace Hexalith.Parties.Platform.LifecycleTests;
+
+/// <summary>Explicit real-service qualification fixture; no absent control or environment can skip it.</summary>
+public sealed class LifecycleQualificationTests(PlatformEnvironmentFixture fixture, ITestOutputHelper output) : IClassFixture<PlatformEnvironmentFixture>
+{
+    /// <summary>Proves the real persistence path before exposing a bounded controller-owned execution phase.</summary>
+    /// <returns>The real-service assertion and finite controlled terminal outcome.</returns>
+    [Fact]
+    public async Task PersistRealPartyThenObserveExplicitQualificationControl()
+    {
+        using var bound = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(TestContext.Current.CancellationToken);
+        bound.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(240));
+        string runId = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("HEXALITH_G4_RUN_ID") ?? string.Empty;
+        Assert.True(runId.Length == 32 && runId.All(character => character is >= '0' and <= '9' or >= 'a' and <= 'f'));
+        string directory = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "hexalith-builds", "ci-qualification", runId);
+        string control = Path.Combine(directory, "control.json");
+        _ = await ReadActionAsync(control, runId, bound.Token).ConfigureAwait(true);
+
+        await new PartyEnvironmentTests(fixture, output).RealDependencies_CreateQueryAndPersistMatchingPartyEvents().ConfigureAwait(true);
+
+        string descriptor = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("HEXALITH_TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PATH") ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("The real runner descriptor is required.");
+        byte[] descriptorBytes = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(descriptor, bound.Token).ConfigureAwait(true);
+        string ready = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
+        {
+            runId,
+            phase = "execution",
+            observedAtUtc = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
+            processId = Environment.ProcessId,
+            descriptorSha256 = Convert.ToHexStringLower(SHA256.HashData(descriptorBytes)),
+            realPersistenceAssertionsPassed = true,
+        });
+        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(Path.Combine(directory, "execution-ready.json"), ready, bound.Token).ConfigureAwait(true);
+        while (true)
+        {
+            string action = await ReadActionAsync(control, runId, bound.Token).ConfigureAwait(true);
+            if (action == "pass")
+            {
+                bound.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
+                await new PartyPersistenceAssertions(fixture, output).RecheckAsync().ConfigureAwait(true);
+                return;
+            }
+
+            Assert.True(action != "fail", "Intentional qualification failing-suite outcome.");
+            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100), bound.Token).ConfigureAwait(true);
+        }
+    }
+
+    private static async Task<string> ReadActionAsync(string path, string runId, CancellationToken token)
+    {
+        FileInfo file = new(path);
+        Assert.True(file.Exists && file.LinkTarget is null && file.Length is > 0 and <= 4096, "Missing or unsafe explicit qualification control.");
+        using JsonDocument document = JsonDocument.Parse(await File.ReadAllTextAsync(path, token).ConfigureAwait(true));
+        Assert.Equal(runId, document.RootElement.GetProperty("runId").GetString());
+        string action = document.RootElement.GetProperty("action").GetString() ?? string.Empty;
+        Assert.Contains(action, new[] { "wait", "pass", "fail" });
+        return action;
+    }
+}"},{"sha":"37e594e0fe8513ff0ab3a18982fd9174a67d2729","filename":"tests/ci-lifecycle/test_cancellation_phase.py","status":"added","additions":132,"deletions":0,"changes":132,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/blob/f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570/tests%2Fci-lifecycle%2Ftest_cancellation_phase.py","raw_url":"https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/raw/f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570/tests%2Fci-lifecycle%2Ftest_cancellation_phase.py","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/contents/tests%2Fci-lifecycle%2Ftest_cancellation_phase.py?ref=f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,132 @@
+"""Explicit unit state/receipt doubles only; no fabricated positive CI context or native qualification."""
+import copy
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'scripts/qualify-disposable-ci.py'
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cancellation_phase', SCRIPT)
+Q = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(Q)
+CONTEXT = {'kind': 'unit-state-control-only'}
+
+
+def facts(phase='startup'):
+    clock = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=3)
+    stamp = lambda seconds: (clock + timedelta(seconds=seconds)).isoformat()
+    owner = {'runId': 'a' * 32, 'attemptId': 'b' * 32, 'environmentId': 'c' * 32, 'executionContext': CONTEXT}
+    item = {'cancellationPhase': phase, 'cancellationReadyAtUtc': stamp(0),
+            'cancellationSignals': [{'signal': 2, 'observedAtUtc': stamp(1)}]}
+    snapshot = {**owner, 'status': 'Starting', 'stateUpdatedAtUtc': stamp(0),
+                'readStartedAtUtc': stamp(1.1), 'observedAtUtc': stamp(1.2),
+                'firstOutcome': None, 'stateTestTerminal': None, 'nativeExecution': None}
+    if phase == 'execution':
+        item['executionCheckpoint'] = {'runId': owner['runId'], 'realPersistenceAssertionsPassed': True,
+                                       'processId': 123, 'birth': '456'}
+        item['admission'] = {'ownerRunId': owner['runId'], 'environmentId': owner['environmentId'],
+                             'attachedRunId': 'd' * 32, 'originalAttachmentRequestId': 'e' * 32,
+                             'requestedHoldSeconds': 240, 'effectiveHoldSeconds': 240,
+                             'acceptedAtUtc': stamp(0), 'expiresAtUtc': stamp(240),
+                             'endedAtUtc': None, 'outcome': None}
+        snapshot.update(status='Ready', nativeExecution={'processId': 123, 'birth': '456'}, admission=copy.deepcopy(item['admission']))
+    item['cancellationSnapshot'] = snapshot
+    return owner, item
+
+
+class CancellationPhaseTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_startup_requires_actual_starting_without_execution_or_first_terminal(self):
+        owner, item = facts()
+        Q.cancellation_phase(item, owner, CONTEXT)
+        for changes in ({'status': 'Ready'}, {'status': 'Ready', 'nativeExecution': {'processId': 123, 'birth': '456'}},
+                        {'status': 'Failed'}, {'stateTestTerminal': {'terminalStatus': 'failed'}},
+                        {'firstOutcome': {'terminalStatus': 'failed'}}):
+            changed = copy.deepcopy(item)
+            changed['cancellationSnapshot'].update(changes)
+            with self.subTest(actual=changes), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                Q.cancellation_phase(changed, owner, CONTEXT)
+
+    def test_missing_snapshot_bad_job_or_time_cannot_supply_phase_credit(self):
+        owner, item = facts()
+        for snapshot in (None, {}, {**item['cancellationSnapshot'], 'failureType': 'FileNotFoundError'},
+                         {**item['cancellationSnapshot'], 'executionContext': {'kind': 'other-unit-context'}},
+                         {**item['cancellationSnapshot'], 'runId': 'f' * 32},
+                         {**item['cancellationSnapshot'], 'readStartedAtUtc': item['cancellationReadyAtUtc']}):
+            changed = {**item, 'cancellationSnapshot': snapshot}
+            with self.subTest(snapshot=snapshot), self.assertRaises((ValueError, KeyError)):
+                Q.cancellation_phase(changed, owner, CONTEXT)
+
+    def test_execution_requires_same_running_process_and_original_active_finite_admission(self):
+        owner, item = facts('execution')
+        Q.cancellation_phase(item, owner, CONTEXT)
+        for changes in ({'status': 'Starting'}, {'nativeExecution': None},
+                        {'nativeExecution': {'processId': 123, 'birth': 'reused'}},
+                        {'admission': {**item['admission'], 'expiresAtUtc': '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'}},
+                        {'admission': {**item['admission'], 'outcome': 'withdrawn'}},
+                        {'admission': {**item['admission'], 'environmentId': 'f' * 32}}):
+            changed = copy.deepcopy(item)
+            changed['cancellationSnapshot'].update(changes)
+            with self.subTest(actual=changes), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                Q.cancellation_phase(changed, owner, CONTEXT)
+
+    def test_signal_snapshot_reads_current_state_without_archived_starting_fallback(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
+            root = Path(temporary)
+            owner, item = facts()
+            owner['stateDirectory'] = str(root / 'native-unit-state')
+            active = Path(owner['stateDirectory']) / (owner['runId'] + '.json')
+            diagnostic = Path(owner['stateDirectory']) / 'diagnostics' / owner['runId']
+            Q.write(active, {**owner, 'status': 'Ready', 'updatedAt': Q.now()})
+            Q.write(diagnostic / 'owner.json', {**owner, 'status': 'Starting', 'updatedAt': Q.now()})
+            controller = object.__new__(Q.Qualification)
+            controller.context = CONTEXT
+            controller.issued = lambda _: owner
+            controller.diagnostics = lambda _: diagnostic
+            controller.save = lambda: Q.write(root / 'retained-journal.json', item)
+            controller.observe = lambda kind, **value: Q.write(root / 'retained-snapshot.json', value)
+            with patch.object(controller, 'state') as archived_fallback:
+                controller.cancellation_snapshot(item)
+                archived_fallback.assert_not_called()
+            self.assertEqual(item['cancellationSnapshot']['status'], 'Ready')
+            self.assertEqual(Q.read(root / 'retained-journal.json')['cancellationSnapshot']['status'], 'Ready')
+            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                Q.cancellation_phase(item, owner, CONTEXT)
+            active.unlink()
+            controller.cancellation_snapshot(item)
+            self.assertEqual(item['cancellationSnapshot']['failureType'], 'FileNotFoundError')
+            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                Q.cancellation_phase(item, owner, CONTEXT)
+

+        for actual in (None, {}, {'failureType': 'OSError'}, {'status': 'Ready'}):

+                controller.context = CONTEXT
+                controller.evidence = directory
+                controller.journal = {'owners': [item, {'label': 'peer', 'receipt': str(receipt)}]}
+                controller.issued = lambda _: owner
+                controller.recover_launch = lambda _: None
+                controller.diagnostics = lambda _: directory
+                controller.resume_host = lambda _: None
+                controller.settled_child = lambda _: None
+                observations = []
+                controller.observe = lambda kind, **value: observations.append(value)
+                with patch.object(controller, 'down') as down, patch.object(Q.HELPER, 'retain_artifacts') as retain, \
+                     patch.object(controller, 'finalize_cancellation') as credit:
+                    self.assertEqual(controller.finalize('cancelled'), 1)
+                self.assertEqual(down.call_count, 2)
+                self.assertEqual(retain.call_count, 2)
+                credit.assert_not_called()
+                self.assertFalse(observations[-1]['issuedOwnersCleanupVerified'])
+                self.assertFalse(observations[-1]['candidateAcceptance'])
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()"},{"sha":"ff8af675ee72f2ec8031f9a00d62404ebd592c68","filename":"tests/ci-lifecycle/test_launch_recovery.py","status":"added","additions":274,"deletions":0,"changes":274,"blob_url":"https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/blob/f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570/tests%2Fci-lifecycle%2Ftest_launch_recovery.py","raw_url":"https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/raw/f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570/tests%2Fci-lifecycle%2Ftest_launch_recovery.py","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/contents/tests%2Fci-lifecycle%2Ftest_launch_recovery.py?ref=f1f33f8de655d9aa9307bafba128b0c7ea5c2570","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,274 @@
+"""Bounded actual-process controls of the controller gate; no CLI, fake CI context or native owner is used."""
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'scripts/qualify-disposable-ci.py'
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('launch_qualification', SCRIPT)
+Q = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(Q)
+REAL_POPEN = subprocess.Popen
+IMPORT = ('import importlib.util, sys; '
+          f'spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("qualification", {str(SCRIPT)!r}); '
+          'q=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(q); ')
+
+
+def controller(directory):
+    value = object.__new__(Q.Qualification)
+    value.temporary = Q.private_directory(Path(directory) / 'controller')
+    value.evidence = Q.private_directory(Path(directory) / 'retained-evidence')
+    value.journal_path = value.temporary / 'journal.json'
+    value.journal = {'classification': 'local-process-control-no-hosted-credit', 'owners': [], 'observations': []}
+    value.children = {}
+    value.save()
+    return value
+
+
+def gated_command(item, marker):
+    journal = str(Path(item['receipt']).parent.parent / 'journal.json')
+    payload = ('import json, os; from pathlib import Path; '
+               f'entry=next(item for item in json.loads(Path({journal!r}).read_text())["owners"] if item["label"]=={item["label"]!r}); '
+               'assert entry["pid"]==os.getpid() and entry["processGroup"]==os.getpgrp(); '
+               f'Path({str(marker)!r}).write_text("executed after durable actual process bookkeeping")')
+    harmless = [sys.executable, '-c', payload]
+    return [sys.executable, '-B', '-c', IMPORT + f'raise SystemExit(q.gated_exec({item!r}, {harmless!r}))']
+
+
+def independent_finalizer(original):
+    recovered = controller(original.temporary.parent / 'unused')
+    recovered.temporary = original.temporary

+"""Source contract controls only; passing these does not qualify a hosted environment."""
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import unittest
+from xml.etree import ElementTree
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+
+
+class WorkflowBoundaryTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_baseline_keeps_every_existing_isolated_project_consumer_and_native_gate(self):
+        ordinary = (ROOT / '.github/workflows/ci.yml').read_text()
+        workflow = (ROOT / '.github/workflows/ci-lifecycle-qualification.yml').read_text()
+        baseline = workflow.split('  qualification:', 1)[0]
+        def isolated(text):
+            return re.search(r'unit-test-projects: \|\n((?:        tests/[^\n]+\n)+)', text).group(1).split()
+        self.assertEqual(isolated(baseline), isolated(ordinary))
+        self.assertEqual(len(isolated(baseline)), 15)
+        for setting in ('integration-test-profiles: platform-package', 'run-consumer-validation: true'):
+            self.assertIn(setting, baseline)
+        reference = r'Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds/.github/workflows/domain-ci-v2.yml@[0-9a-f]{40}'
+        self.assertEqual(re.search(reference, baseline).group(), re.search(reference, ordinary).group())
+        self.assertIn('    needs: baseline\n', workflow)
+        self.assertNotIn('continue-on-error', workflow)
+        self.assertNotIn('--filter-trait', workflow)
+        self.assertNotIn('--filter-not-trait', workflow)
+
+    def test_reader_permissions_and_independent_finalizer_remain_explicit(self):
+        workflow = (ROOT / '.github/workflows/ci-lifecycle-qualification.yml').read_text()
+        self.assertIn('permissions:\n  contents: read\n', workflow)
+        self.assertEqual(set(re.findall(r'secrets\.([A-Z_]+)', workflow)),
+                         {'HEXALITH_CI_REGISTRY_USERNAME', 'HEXALITH_CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD'})
+        self.assertNotIn('secrets: inherit', workflow)
+        self.assertNotIn('--recursive', workflow)
+        self.assertIn('cancel-in-progress: false', workflow)
+        finalizer = workflow.split('- name: Independently finalize every exact same-job owner', 1)[1]
+        self.assertTrue(finalizer.lstrip().startswith('if: always()'))
+        self.assertIn('ACTUAL_JOB_STATUS: ${{ job.status }}', finalizer)
+        self.assertIn('finalize --job-status "$ACTUAL_JOB_STATUS"', finalizer)
+        self.assertLess(workflow.index('name: lifecycle-cancellation-ready'),
+                        workflow.index('- name: Await parent cancellation'))
+        self.assertNotIn('gh run cancel', workflow)
+
+    def test_qualification_is_explicit_package_suite_excluded_from_ordinary_solution_build(self):
+        manifest = json.loads((ROOT / 'module/hexalith.module-manifest.v2.json').read_text())
+        suites = {suite['name']: suite for suite in manifest['modules'][0]['tests']}
+        self.assertIn('platform-source', suites)
+        self.assertIn('platform-package', suites)
+        suite = suites['lifecycle-package']
+        self.assertEqual(suite['mode'], 'package')
+        self.assertEqual(suite['executor'], 'mtp')
+        self.assertEqual(suite['executionTimeoutSeconds'], 300)
+        self.assertEqual(suite['stopTimeoutSeconds'], 90)
+        for solution in ['Hexalith.Parties.slnx', 'Hexalith.Parties.Standalone.slnx']:
+            project = ElementTree.parse(ROOT / solution).find(f'.//Project[@Path="{suite["entry"]}"]')
+            self.assertIsNotNone(project)
+            self.assertEqual(project.find('Build').attrib['Project'], 'false')
+        source = (ROOT / 'tests/Hexalith.Parties.Platform.LifecycleTests/LifecycleQualificationTests.cs').read_text()
+        assertion = 'RealDependencies_CreateQueryAndPersistMatchingPartyEvents()'
+        self.assertLess(source.index(assertion), source.index('realPersistenceAssertionsPassed = true'))
+        self.assertEqual(source.count(assertion), 1)
+        recheck = 'new PartyPersistenceAssertions(fixture, output).RecheckAsync()'
+        self.assertEqual(source.count(recheck), 1)
+        self.assertGreater(source.index(recheck), source.index('if (action == "pass")'))
+        self.assertNotIn('Skip', source)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()"}]}
